newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Foster's says Mildara growth on track.
newsitem.headline: Foster's says Mildara growth on track.

text.p: Foster's Brewing Group Ltd said on Monday wine maker Mildara Blass was on track for 15 percent profit growth in 1996/97, which it needed to reach a earnings before interest and tax target of A$100 million by 2000/01.

"(Mildara Blass) has been absolutely consistent with achieving that 15 percent per annum profit growth which is necessary to achieve our objective which to double the EBIT of that business over five years," Fosters chief executive, Ted Kunkel told a news conference.
Kunkel said when Foster's purchased Mildara in February 1996, its EBIT stood at about A$50 million.
Kunkel said the Mildara Blass EBIT target for the year 2000/01 could be achieved without further acquisitions but said any purchase in the sector would add to the division's profits.
"That (EBIT) target can be expected essentially from organic growth. Acquisitions, where opportunities arise, will add further to those profits."
Kunkel declined to comment on whether the company was considering another wine acquisition, but noted that Australian wine businesses were currently overpriced.
Foster's most recent wine acquisition was Rothbury Wines Ltd which it bought in July last year.
